chunks: Who creates first then reverts it? And who gives you provision from the heavens and the earth? Is there any other god along with God? Tell them: "Bring your proof, if you are truthful."
ai.seo_question: What are the two main proofs of God's oneness mentioned in Surah An-Naml verse 643?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah An-Naml, this verse serves as a rhetorical climax to the discourse on divine unity, emphasizing Allah's absolute sovereignty over both origin (al-bada') and sustenance (al-rizq). Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai, highlight the logical progression from the physical act of creation to the metaphysical challenge of proof (burhan), asserting that polytheism lacks rational foundation when compared to the evident signs of God's power in the cosmos.
